headline: Wardens Edge Ahead in Weathered Expanse as Linn of Mercy Reconsolidates
war_summary: Since our last edition the Weathered Expanse has tipped Warden-ward: the ruin that split its line has vanished from the ledger, leaving five Warden bases to four Colonial, though Crow's Nest—scene of fifteen recorded actions in the day—has gone quiet these past two hours. The Linn of Mercy tells the opposite tale; its demolished post is back on the roll and all eleven bases fly Colonial colors, yet the guns have not ceased, Lathair logging nine events with movement as late as 19:41. Fisherman's Row, wholly Colonial, still crackles in the evening hours, Black Well and Dankana Post the busiest grounds. Stonecradle's flags have not shifted since before dawn—three Warden to six Colonial—while its casualty ledger swells past twenty-six thousand in a day. The Nevish Line and Mooring County bleed heavily without a flag moving, and the Dead Lands exact a steep Warden toll. Stlican Shelf holds at five Warden to four Colonial; the Gutter's Parras has been silent since early evening. No victor is declared on the war's 341st day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
